name: emailpro-root
description: EmailPro Lead Generation & Email Campaign Platform Root Launcher

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm install --include=dev --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.render-build: npm install --include=dev && npm install --include=dev --prefix backend && npm install --include=dev --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.install-all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
